desc: Write code to read N, S, T from stdin.
Build a mapping from characters in S to characters in T. Check for consistency (if a character in S maps to two different characters in T, return -1).
Count the number of distinct mappings where the source character is different from the target character.
Build a directed graph where each edge is a distinct mapping (s_char -> t_char).
Detect if there is a cycle in the graph.
If there is a cycle, check if there is any character in the lowercase English alphabet that does not appear in T.
If there is a cycle and no such character, output -1.
If there is a cycle and such a character exists, output (number of distinct mappings) + 1.
If there is no cycle, output the number of distinct mappings.
